families.name: Adaptive piecewise response models
families.question: Does a small mixture of local response functions capture heterogeneity missed by one global model?
families.experiment: Compare a soft-gated mixture with one linear model and a capacity-matched nonlinear baseline on the same rows and split.
families.pitfalls: Tiny effective segments can overfit; check per-segment support and latency.

families.name: Prediction-to-decision mapping
families.question: Would a different action rule improve the declared business objective with the same predictions?
families.experiment: Freeze the predictor and validation protocol; compare a threshold, score fusion or feasible-set rule against the current decision rule.
families.pitfalls: A higher click score is not an incremental treatment effect; use observed value and cost only when their definitions are valid.

families.name: Typed knowledge-graph retrieval
families.question: Do typed entity relations add retrieval signal beyond interaction and item-side baselines?
families.experiment: Hold the candidate pool and evaluation protocol fixed; ablate relation-aware information against matched item representations.
families.pitfalls: Entity links or graph edges formed after the evaluation cutoff leak future information.

families.name: Graph neighborhood and proximity representations
families.question: Do supplied graph neighborhoods or proximity objectives add signal beyond independent item features?
families.experiment: Keep the data cutoff, labels, candidate universe and evaluator fixed; replace one model component with a simple control and compare held-out slices.
families.pitfalls: Graph/position/popularity inputs require explicit provenance; structural assumptions alone do not identify causal effects.

families.name: Logged-feedback factorization
families.question: Does explicit exposure or popularity factorization improve the declared prediction target under supported assumptions?
families.experiment: Keep the data cutoff, labels, candidate universe and evaluator fixed; replace one model component with a simple control and compare held-out slices.
families.pitfalls: Graph/position/popularity inputs require explicit provenance; structural assumptions alone do not identify causal effects.

families.name: Query-group ranking objectives
families.question: Does a grouped ranking objective improve ordering with the same scores, labels and candidate universe?
families.experiment: Hold backbone and queries fixed; compare pointwise loss, RankNet and detached DeltaNDCG-weighted pairs.
families.pitfalls: Cross-query pairs, padded candidates and metric weights with unsupported relevance labels invalidate the comparison.
